Professor of Medicine

Accomplishment
1. President of North American Taiwanese Medical Association ( NATMA 北美洲台灣人醫師協會總會會長) 2002-2003

2. Founder of NATMA International Medical Mission (國際義診) 2003

3. President of the North American Taiwanese Medical Association-New York Chapter (NATMA/NY 北美台灣人醫師學會紐約分會會長) 1998

4. Chairman of the North American Taiwanese Medical Association Foundation (北美洲台灣人醫師協會基金會) 2016-2017

5. Lifetime CEO of the Taiwanese Golf Association (台灣人高爾夫球俱樂部永遠董事長) 1985-present; established a golf school for members

6. Co-Founder of the Global Taiwan Institute (GTI) 2017

7. Member of the Board of Directors for the Taiwan Center/New York, over 10 years

8. Full Professor of Medicine, New York Medical College

9. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 10/2018
